fact: A DGCT presentation of 15 July 2021 states that 15% of communes remain without internet access, that unconnected collectivities are a major brake on digitalisation, and sets an objective to connect 100% of collectivities (satellite in white zones) by Q4 2022.
title: Site web type des collectivités territoriales
publisher: Direction Générale des Collectivités Territoriales, Ministère de l'Intérieur
